title: Learning: The Leader Who Came Back
text: A leader was cut off for a while. An election may have happened without it. Messages carry a term number, if anyone compares.
held: Every message was from the current term, and everyone checked.

cards.label: Reject it and reply with your term
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: term
fields.check: Compare the message's term with your own

intrusion.detail: This message is from term 3. You are in term 4.
intrusion.correct: Reject it and reply with your term
intrusion.why: A message from an old term comes from a leader that has been replaced. Accepting it lets two leaders write to one log.
intrusion.reveal: The entry came from a leader still in term 3, after the cluster had moved to term 4.

temptations.label: Accept it: it came from the node you know as leader
temptations.why: Who led last term says nothing about this one. The term number decides, not familiarity.

cards.label: Step down: there is a newer term
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: reply's term
fields.check: Read the term in the reply
fields.ok: Same term as yours. You are still leader.

intrusion.detail: The follower is in term 5. You are in term 4.
intrusion.correct: Step down: there is a newer term
intrusion.why: A higher term anywhere means there was an election you missed. A leader that sees one stops leading at once.
intrusion.reveal: The follower's reply carried term 5: the Leader had been replaced without knowing.

cards.label: Treat it as saved only once all 3 confirm
cards.why: A majority is the rule. Any later leader must come from a majority, and every majority contains a node that has this entry.

teaches: Every message carries a term. An older term is refused; a newer one makes you step down.
A leader doesn't find out it was replaced until it reads a reply.
